overall_summary: The channel has a very small sample size of 10 videos with very low view counts (ranging from 5 to 33 views), making it difficult to establish statistically significant winning patterns. However, themes related to 'self respect' and personal boundaries (e.g., video ID AfaLxMy6FMY with 33 views) slightly outperformed passive yearning.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (self respect) achieved the highest views (33) compared to pure sad/passive themes.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate a subtle shift from helplessness to self-preservation in future scripts.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing solely on waiting or generic night thoughts (e.g., 'aUuNKfe7jm4', 'uIbMpCjVutQ') stayed at the absolute baseline of 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely passive setups; every sad moment must have an active, tangible daily trigger.
